description: GEO Tool Check helps users assess whether a public page can be read, understood, and cited by AI search systems. It scores page readiness, checks whether major AI crawlers are blocked, and evaluates draft passages for citability. Checks run without an account or API key and use the same scoring logic as geo-tool.com.

defaultPrompt: Check my website for AI-search readiness and explain the three most important improvements.
Check whether my website allows major AI crawlers such as GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
Analyze my website text for AI citability and suggest how to make it easier for AI systems to quote and reference.
